# Acceptance Criteria & Edge-Case Coverage Checklist: 谱文编辑器 Word 化与常用格式

**Purpose**: Validate the *quality of the requirements themselves* for the 003 acceptance criteria (SC-001…SC-008) and the edge/exception scenarios — are they measurable, unambiguous, complete, and consistent with 002? This is a "unit test for requirements writing", not an implementation/QA test.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · related [plan.md](../plan.md) · [tasks.md](../tasks.md)
**Note**: Custom checklist generated by `/speckit-checklist` (domain: 验收标准质量 + 边界/异常覆盖). Reviewer-owned.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality — it does NOT mean implementation work is complete.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` = reviewer approved the requirement-quality criterion. Leave `[ ]` when the requirement still needs clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.

---

## Acceptance Criteria Quality (Measurability)

- [ ] CHK001 Are the recruitment criteria for SC-001's "从未用过本增强的编辑者" defined — who qualifies as a naive subject, how many, and is the 5-minute task script fixed/identical across runs? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "成功率 ≥90%" in SC-001 objectively measurable — defined sample size, per-user pass/fail definition, and who records the result? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK003 For SC-002 "格式还原一致率 100%", is "一致" operationally defined (structural/field comparison vs visual), and does it explicitly enumerate every mark it must cover (bold/italic/underline/list/align/heading/font-size/image-width)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK004 SC-003 "≥80% 在无提示下能指出工具栏分组与纸面边界" — is the measurement method defined (sample size, what counts as "指出", acceptable tolerance)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK005 SC-004 "3 秒内说出当前页码并成功切到另一页" — is the timing start trigger defined (from page load? from instruction?), and is the interaction with the 切页保存失败 path covered inside this metric? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004 / §Edge "只读与保存失败"]
- [ ] CHK006 SC-005 "出现次数为 0（含灰色占位）" — is the inspection scope/procedure defined (which surfaces, automated vs manual, and what detects a grayed "即将开放" placeholder)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK007 SC-006 "无法通过界面或直接写入改动格式" — stated as a requirement, is the *server-side* enforcement expectation explicit (not just UI hiding) and traced to the authoritative 002 clause rather than re-specified here? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006 / FR-016]
- [ ] CHK008 SC-007 "格式能力可达率 100%" and "≤2 次点击" — is "可达" defined (visible-and-operable vs merely present in DOM), and is the 2-click budget measured from a stated entry point? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK009 SC-008 "满足 002 对应成功标准" — does it name the specific 002 SC IDs it depends on, so the regression scope is unambiguous rather than "对应标准"? [Traceability, Spec §SC-008]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Empty-selection pending mark (FR-007 / Edge "空选区点格式按钮"): is "不可见格式残片" defined/observable, and is the behavior under an auto-save firing while only pending is active (no new keystroke yet) specified — save MUST NOT persist a phantom mark? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007 / §Edge]
- [ ] CHK011 Paste sanitization (FR-013): is the exact allow-list enumerable (node types + marks), and does it define handling of hyperlinks/anchors and "外链样式" — drop the style but keep readable text/link, or drop the link entirely? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Paste nested→single layer (FR-013 / Edge "粘贴"): is the flatten rule specified for BOTH ordered and unordered lists, and for headings/other blocks nested inside lists (flatten to flat items vs drop)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 List/heading mutual exclusion (Edge "列表与标题混用"): is "互斥" precisely defined — can a heading also be a list item, or are they exclusive block types — and is precedence ("后点的胜出") unambiguous when both are toggled? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge / FR-008 / FR-010]
- [ ] CHK014 List nesting rejection (FR-008 / Edge "列表嵌套"): does the spec define the explicit user-visible reaction when Tab/"增加缩进" is pressed (no-op, caret moves, or block), rather than only stating MUST NOT? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Narrow screen (Edge "窄屏" / FR-002): are target breakpoints/min width defined, and is "纸面可缩小但仍居中可读" given a readability floor (minimum font/width)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge / FR-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Read-only & save failure (Edge "只读与保存失败"): for the editor path (not viewer), is the save-failure retry/resume behavior specified (keep edits, topbar MUST NOT show "已保存") and aligned with 002's exact save-state wording? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge / FR-016]
- [ ] CHK017 Old-doc compatibility (Edge "旧文兼容" / FR-017): for 002-era content with no alignment/marks, does the spec define the default toolbar/rendering state (e.g., default align = left, marks inactive) so a re-open cannot mis-display new controls? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge / FR-017]
- [ ] CHK018 Mini page chip source (FR-005 / Edge "迷你纸页片段来源"): for a page never loaded and with no cached snapshot, is the fallback defined (blank/page-number only, no error), and is "上次成功保存内容" guaranteed available client-side without a refetch? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK019 Mini page chip deleted/empty page (FR-005): does the spec cover a page deleted in another tab while its chip is shown, or an empty page mid-edit (render blank/number, no crash)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005 / US2 AS4]
- [ ] CHK020 Viewer formatting visibility (FR-018 / US3): is "MUST NOT 显示，仅禁用态不可接受" unambiguously testable (toolbar DOM absent vs merely hidden), and does it cover ALL writer controls including image-upload and "立即保存"? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]

## Exception / Recovery / Non-Functional Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Recovery: when a per-page format save partially fails or conflicts (concurrent edit / version clash), is the recovery path specified, or explicitly deferred to 002 with a confirmed reference? [Gap, Spec §FR-016 / §Edge]
- [ ] CHK022 Exception: if stored content somehow contains a disallowed mark (legacy color, tampered payload), is there an on-load sanitization requirement so rendering/serialization cannot reintroduce banned formats? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK023 Non-Functional (performance): are typing/format-operation latency expectations under load defined, or explicitly declared out of scope for this round? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK024 Accessibility: is keyboard operability of the new ribbon toolbar specified (focus order, ARIA roles, visible focus) — distinct from the optional shortcuts in FR-019? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-019 / FR-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Security/authz consistency: SC-006's "越权访问仍按不存在处理" — is it traced to the same 002 clause as FR-016, ensuring a single authoritative requirement rather than a duplicated one? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006 / FR-016]

## Consistency & Traceability

- [ ] CHK026 FR-011 supersedes 002 FR-031 — does the spec guarantee no future double-spec, and is a cross-reference note in 002's doc (to avoid contradictory "MUST NOT" guidance surviving) required/planned? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK027 FR-004 "MUST NOT vendoring 第三方谱系产品主题/皮肤（含 AGPL）" — is this AGPL licensing boundary recorded in a decision/ADR (not only the spec) so it survives later spec edits? [Traceability, Spec §FR-004 / Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Scope-drift guard: FR-012 enumerates banned capabilities (color, line-height, table, blockquote, alt, caption, outline library, nested lists, task checklist) — does this list exactly match the Clarifications exclusions, or are there items present in one but absent in the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012 / §Clarifications]

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and MUST NOT modify these markers.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied; leave `[ ]` for items still needing clarification, correction, or evaluation.
